text: Integration of ecosystem-based adaptation into national design guidelines; explicit transboundary action plan with Viet Nam; institutionalization via the National Flood Forecasting Center (NFFC); large-scale irrigation and drainage rehabilitation covering over 16,000 hectares; strong gender mainstreaming with 30% female representation in community-based disaster risk management committees.
